topic: Nagato uses Rinne Rebirth to bring back the people his attack took from Konoha, at the cost of his own life
title: Nagato's Rinne Rebirth: Why Pain Undid His Own Plan
description:
Nagato's Rinne Rebirth brought back the people Pain's attack took from Konoha. Why would the man who flattened the village spend his whole life to undo it? This breakdown argues the jutsu's own rules show it was a bet on Naruto, not a surrender.

0:00 The Question
0:35 The Silent Bodies
3:10 A Question Left Hanging
6:00 The Story Naruto Heard
9:10 Konan's Warning
12:20 The Man Left Behind
14:50 The Verdict

Was Nagato's last act proof that Pain was wrong, or proof his heart was always about peace?
comment: Was Nagato's Rinne Rebirth a confession that Pain was wrong, or a bet that Naruto could win what Pain couldn't? Pick one.

lines.text: Nagato's Rinne Rebirth wasn't a surrender. It was a bet on Naruto, and I can prove it.

lines.text: So here's my verdict, and I'll say it as a theory, because the story never gives us Nagato's own summary.

lines.text: Rinne Rebirth was not a confession that Pain was wrong about suffering.

lines.text: Look at the three details. The Outer Path kept the power for his real body, so the choice was always his alone.
